objective.name: user_message
objective.description: Defines the block of the news of an inference that designates the user messages absorbed by the chain in progress since the previous inference.

functional._message_ids_note: Required. Identifiers of the absorbed user messages, in arrival order. The messages themselves are lines of the journal and are read in the conversation; the block only says which of them are new. It is separate from the active stimulus, which may be pending at the same time.
